display.name: Apple Metal Overview
display.description: A compact starting point for SDK sessions and correlated Apple investigations. Full captures remain local.

display.name: Session
display.description: SDK sessions discovered in the selected measurement time range.

spec.query: SELECT attributes->>'session_id' AS session FROM records WHERE kind='log' AND span_name IN ('game.performance.window','app.responsiveness.window') AND attributes->>'session_id' IS NOT NULL GROUP BY session ORDER BY max(start_timestamp) DESC LIMIT 100

display.name: Build
display.description: Leave empty to show all records. Paste an exact build ID to filter.

spec.text: Choose one session and zoom to minutes. Expand Events for runtime and build links.

display.name: Recent SDK sessions
display.description: All observed windows, including the partial tail. Callback and presented rates use counts divided by observed elapsed time. CPU is duration-weighted relative to one core. Missing presentation data stays empty. GPU is the worst window p95.

spec.query:
WITH frame AS (
 SELECT attributes->>'session_id' AS session, attributes->>'build.id' AS build,
 max(start_timestamp) AS measured,
 CASE WHEN count(DISTINCT attributes->>'render_mode')>1 THEN 'multiple modes' ELSE max(attributes->>'render_mode') END AS game,
 count(*) AS windows,
 sum(CASE WHEN attributes->>'window.partial'='false' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS complete_windows,
 SUM(CAST(attributes->>'frames' AS DOUBLE)) / NULLIF(SUM(CAST(attributes->>'frames' AS DOUBLE) / NULLIF(CAST(attributes->>'render_callback_fps' AS DOUBLE),0)),0) AS callback_hz,
 SUM(CAST(attributes->>'display_presentation_intervals' AS DOUBLE)) / NULLIF(SUM(CAST(attributes->>'display_presentation_intervals' AS DOUBLE) / NULLIF(CAST(attributes->>'display_presented_fps' AS DOUBLE),0)),0) AS presented_fps,
 max(CAST(attributes->>'gpu_command_p95_ms' AS DOUBLE)) AS gpu_worst_window_p95_ms
 FROM records WHERE kind='log' AND span_name='game.performance.window' AND ($session = 'all' OR attributes->>'session_id' = $session) AND ($build = '' OR attributes->>'build.id' = $build)
 GROUP BY session,build
), cpu AS (
 SELECT attributes->>'session_id' AS session, attributes->>'build.id' AS build, max(start_timestamp) AS measured,
 100 * sum(CAST(attributes->>'main_thread.cpu.utilization' AS DOUBLE) * CAST(attributes->>'window_seconds' AS DOUBLE)) / NULLIF(sum(CAST(attributes->>'window_seconds' AS DOUBLE)),0) AS main_thread_one_core_pct
 FROM records WHERE kind='log' AND span_name='app.responsiveness.window' AND ($session = 'all' OR attributes->>'session_id' = $session) AND ($build = '' OR attributes->>'build.id' = $build)
 GROUP BY session,build
)
SELECT left(coalesce(frame.session,cpu.session),8) AS session, frame.game,
 round(frame.callback_hz,1) AS callback_hz, round(frame.presented_fps,1) AS presented_fps,
 round(cpu.main_thread_one_core_pct,1) AS "CPU % (1 core)",
 concat(CAST(coalesce(frame.complete_windows,0) AS TEXT),' / ',CAST(coalesce(frame.windows,0) AS TEXT)) AS "complete / all windows"
FROM frame FULL OUTER JOIN cpu ON frame.session=cpu.session AND frame.build IS NOT DISTINCT FROM cpu.build
ORDER BY coalesce(frame.measured,cpu.measured) DESC LIMIT 20

display.name: Native evidence within SDK windows
display.description: Each row is one import and SDK window. Do not sum repeated imports. Waits overlap CPU states. Coverage below 100% limits the conclusion.

spec.query: SELECT left(attributes->>'session_id',8) AS session, left(attributes->>'capture.id',8) AS capture, round(100*CAST(attributes->>'window.coverage_fraction' AS DOUBLE),1) AS coverage_pct, round(CAST(attributes->>'thread.state.Running.ms' AS DOUBLE),1) AS running_ms, round(CAST(attributes->>'thread.state.Blocked.ms' AS DOUBLE),1) AS blocked_ms, round(CAST(attributes->>'window.drawable_wait_ms' AS DOUBLE),1) AS drawable_wait_ms, trace_id,span_id FROM records WHERE kind='log' AND span_name='development.thread.window' AND ($session = 'all' OR attributes->>'session_id' = $session) AND ($build = '' OR attributes->>'build.id' = $build) ORDER BY start_timestamp DESC,capture LIMIT 20

display.name: Investigation findings
display.description: Observations guide the next native investigation. They do not assert an automatic root cause.

spec.query: SELECT left(attributes->>'session_id',8) AS session, attributes->>'diagnostic.observation' AS observation, attributes->>'diagnostic.next_investigation' AS next_investigation, trace_id,span_id FROM records WHERE kind='log' AND span_name='development.diagnostic.finding' AND ($session = 'all' OR attributes->>'session_id' = $session) AND ($build = '' OR attributes->>'build.id' = $build) ORDER BY start_timestamp DESC LIMIT 10

display.name: Main-thread and process CPU activity
display.description: CPU activity as a percentage of one core. Process CPU can exceed 100% across multiple cores. The SDK samples independently of rendering. Dots show isolated observations. Blank intervals mean no observation; stopped sessions are not joined. Source numbers distinguish full source identities and render contexts within this query.

display.name: SDK callback and presented FPS
display.description: Callbacks measure renderer cadence. Presented FPS uses Metal drawable presentation timestamps when the app observes drawables. Partial windows retain final samples. Missing presentation data remains absent. Separate sessions stay separate; zoom to a session for detail.

spec.query: SELECT time_bucket('5 seconds', CAST(attributes->>'recorded_at' AS TIMESTAMPTZ)) AS time, CASE WHEN $session='all' THEN attributes->>'session_id' ELSE 'selected session' END AS session, SUM(CAST(attributes->>'frames' AS DOUBLE)) / NULLIF(SUM(CAST(attributes->>'frames' AS DOUBLE) / NULLIF(CAST(attributes->>'render_callback_fps' AS DOUBLE), 0)), 0) AS "Callbacks", SUM(CAST(attributes->>'display_presentation_intervals' AS DOUBLE)) / NULLIF(SUM(CAST(attributes->>'display_presentation_intervals' AS DOUBLE) / NULLIF(CAST(attributes->>'display_presented_fps' AS DOUBLE), 0)), 0) AS "Presented FPS" FROM records WHERE kind IN ('span', 'log') AND ($session = 'all' OR attributes->>'session_id' = $session) AND ($build = '' OR attributes->>'build.id' = $build) AND span_name = 'game.performance.window' GROUP BY time, session ORDER BY time DESC LIMIT 10000

display.name: Main-queue completed delay and pending age
display.description: Worst completed probe delay and the maximum age of an unfinished probe in each five-second window. One outstanding probe bounds queued work. A blocked queue stays observable before that probe completes. Probe delay includes scheduling latency. Dots show isolated observations. Blank intervals mean no observation; stopped sessions are not joined. Source numbers distinguish full source identities and render contexts within this query.

display.name: Whole-host CPU during game observation
display.description: Whole-Mac load while the companion observes a game. Other apps contribute. Command-R alone supplies no host samples. Dots show isolated samples; gaps stay empty.

spec.query: SELECT time_bucket('5 seconds', CAST(attributes->>'recorded_at' AS TIMESTAMPTZ)) AS time, attributes->>'session_id' AS session, 100 * avg(CAST(attributes->>'cpu_utilization' AS DOUBLE)) AS host_cpu_percent FROM records WHERE kind IN ('span', 'log') AND ($session = 'all' OR attributes->>'session_id' = $session) AND ($build = '' OR attributes->>'build.id' = $build) AND span_name = 'game.host.sample' AND attributes->>'measurement.scope' = 'whole_host' GROUP BY time, session ORDER BY time DESC LIMIT 10000

display.name: Observed Xcode builds
display.description: The Build filter connects runtime records to builds. The Session filter does not apply here because the build command and app have different sessions. Only companion builds provide complete timing.

spec.query: SELECT start_timestamp, trace_id, attributes->>'build.id' AS build, attributes->>'build.configuration' AS configuration, attributes->>'build.scenario' AS scenario, CAST(attributes->>'build.duration_seconds' AS DOUBLE) AS seconds, CAST(attributes->>'build.exit_code' AS DOUBLE) AS exit_code, CAST(attributes->>'build.warnings' AS DOUBLE) AS warnings, CAST(attributes->>'build.errors' AS DOUBLE) AS errors FROM records WHERE kind IN ('span', 'log') AND span_name = 'xcode.build' AND ($build = '' OR attributes->>'build.id' = $build) ORDER BY start_timestamp DESC LIMIT 100

display.name: Gameplay inputs and outcomes
display.description: Real input spans and game outcomes. Scenario lifecycle records remain in the runtime trace. Trace and span columns open the measured record.

spec.query: SELECT start_timestamp AS measured, span_name AS event, attributes->>'game' AS game, attributes->>'score' AS score, trace_id,span_id FROM records WHERE kind IN ('log','span') AND ($session = 'all' OR attributes->>'session_id' = $session) AND ($build = '' OR attributes->>'build.id' = $build) AND span_name IN ('game.session.started','game.line_clear','game.all_clear','game.hold','game.drop','game.rotate','game.maze.cleared','game.collision','game.crash','app.state') ORDER BY start_timestamp DESC LIMIT 30

display.name: Session windows and trace links
display.description: Select one session. Open trace_id or span_id for a report, or build_trace_id for its build. Manual launches can have several independent traces. Full app_session values are filters, not web replay IDs.

spec.query: SELECT start_timestamp AS measured, span_name AS report, trace_id, attributes->>'build.trace_id' AS build_trace_id, span_id, attributes->>'session_id' AS app_session, attributes->>'build.id' AS build FROM records WHERE kind='log' AND span_name IN ('game.performance.window','app.responsiveness.window') AND ($session = 'all' OR attributes->>'session_id' = $session) AND ($build = '' OR attributes->>'build.id' = $build) ORDER BY start_timestamp DESC LIMIT 20

display.name: Frames above 25 ms (%)
display.description: The ratio of raw delta counters counts slow observations directly. A rare stall can be absent from p95. Each source instance and render context remains separate. This threshold is 25 ms, not the display refresh budget. Dots show isolated observations. Blank intervals mean no observation; stopped sessions are not joined. Source numbers distinguish full source identities and render contexts within this query.
